title: Template -- UAC bypass via auto-elevating binary
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1548.002 (Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Bypass User Account Control). A small set of signed Windows binaries auto-elevate without prompting; several of them launch a child process by consulting a per-user registry key an unprivileged process can write. The bypass is therefore visible as an ordinary elevated child of one of those binaries -- fodhelper, computerdefaults, sdclt, eventvwr -- spawning a shell or script host, which those binaries have no legitimate reason to do. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
